full_selection.source_limit: Current reviewed gameplay source, including observation/navigation and supply-intent fixes. Only subsequent documentation/map result metadata changed.

changes.principle: Memoize only pure immutable geometry, bound memory and return detached results.
changes.implementation: Precompute fixed corner links and retain at most 128 exact endpoint-pair routes. Dynamic built footprints still use current ConstructionService geometry.
changes.regression: All fixed entrance pairs and blocked centres match the original uncached Dijkstra route arrays; mutation isolation and eviction checks pass.

changes.principle: Batch repeated reads within a transaction, retain fresh validation at the later commit.
changes.implementation: Selected passenger masses share one fresh holder index; ordinary admission capture reuses its uninterrupted guard facts. Place/manifest metadata reads omit unused load mass.
changes.regression: Six forward components pass including preparation purity, moved passengers, changed loaded-ammunition mass, fresh fuel checks, unique admission and two real issues.

changes.principle: Separate bounded private preparation from indivisible physical admission.
changes.implementation: Newly Ready forward/troop work yields the remaining preparation allowance; a later running pump freshly admits it. Owed elapsed time remains retained.

changes.principle: Bound UI construction and own queued work across lifecycle changes.
changes.implementation: Create one control group per returned frame; retain latest detached status, disconnect old queued work on bind and stop callbacks when prepared.
changes.regression: New row-lifecycle case passes; native populated Workers screen passes at 6.918 ms peak and 0.118 ms action in logs/prototype-coalesced-native/workers, versus the earlier 25.406 ms failure.

changes.principle: Coalesce presentation at a rendered-frame boundary; update counts from committed events.
changes.implementation: One-shot refresh coalescing, explicit-refresh consumption and whole-second arrival countdowns for Workers; focused edits and current physical state are retained.

changes.principle: Avoid forced diagnostic disk synchronization inside measured gameplay.
changes.implementation: Buffer JSONL writes, flush at pause/finish/exit, keep heartbeat and first-failure snapshots immediate. A hard kill can lose the buffered tail; frozen limits and raw violations remain intact.

changes.principle: Assert the real state transition before testing a hidden view.
changes.implementation: Wait two frames and verify Build is selected before hidden course advancement; all four retained native training cases pass in the latest full run.

changes.principle: Avoid duplicate reads within an uninterrupted pure observation.
changes.implementation: Each squad observation lazily reads an objective position once, sharing that exact point across its observers; range, owner filtering, visibility, source ordering and 0.5-second report delay remain unchanged. Next observation reads fresh positions.
changes.regression: Current contact/read guards and frozen training suite all passed; native pointer acceptance also passed.

changes.principle: Keep related presentation work in its reserved frame.
changes.implementation: After deferred navigation selects the current visible panel, consume its pending fresh read in that same presentation frame; direct refresh disconnects the queued duplicate.
changes.regression: Four live guards pass. Ordinary and broad menus still fail their strict frame gate, so this does not establish full FPS compliance.

changes.principle: Keep player intent separate from automatic demand; reconcile promises against actual custody.
changes.implementation: Manual quantities stay fixed. Automatic requests cover only remaining shortage after other promises and actual remaining cargo on cancelled departed manifests. Cancellation holds automatic regeneration until a new explicit request. Reopening invalidates the source notification so the next owned resupply tick publishes fresh need; replacement clears old intent.
changes.regression: All twelve current logistics/report cases passed, including two completed real return cycles, a third cancelled actual departure, manual/automatic promise accounting and session replacement. Controlled component stepping remains separate from ordinary complete-loop and FPS proof.
